name: Product Code Type 1 Code
definition: Type of product codification used to identify a product uniquely.

EA13.name: European Article Number 13
EA13.definition: European Article Number of type-13 also known as International Article Number

EAN8.name: European Article Number 8
EAN8.definition: European Article Number of type-8 also known as International Article Number

GTIN.name: Global Trade Item Number
GTIN.definition: Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) is an identifier for trade items.

OTHR.name: Other
OTHR.definition: Other type of product code classification.

PLUP.name: Price Look Up Codes
PLUP.definition: Price look-up codes, commonly called PLU codes, PLU numbers, PLUs, produce codes, or produce labels, are identification numbers affixed to produce in grocery stores and supermarkets

RS14.name: Reduce Space Symbology 14
RS14.definition: RSS 14 barcode (Reduce Space Symbology) encodes the full  EAN item identification in a symbol that can be omnidirectionally scanned by suitably configured point-of-sale laser scanners.
